components.name: PhyloInk original software and documentation
evidence: User instruction: publish as openly as possible, adding no restrictions beyond third-party requirements, 2026-10-28.
LICENSE

M1a: original projection/compound-scene/cluster implementation and synthetic fixtures. External cluster/paper sources are cited as conceptual inspiration only; no upstream implementation, article text or figure is bundled.

M2: original cumulative-distance phylogram implementation. Paradis (2024) ape vignette cited as background only; no R/ape code, document, figures or dependency included. Hug branch-unit evidence refers to its Figure 2 legend and exact bundled Newick source.

M3a: original rank-policy and classification-parent implementation; NCBI taxonomy citation guidance is background only, with no NCBI dataset, implementation or document bundled. Synthetic classification sample is original 0BSD.

M3b: original unrooted projection, equal-angle construction and bounded daylight heuristic. Yu author documentation is cited for algorithm concepts only; no upstream software, document text, figures, fonts or new dataset are included.
Scope correction: offline local-file search only; original text normalization and pagination. No external provider, name dictionary, runtime package or dataset added.
Local workflow completion: original import staging and offline authoring guide; no new external code, data, fonts or services.

Offline dataset library: original chooser, exact-hash metadata, exhaustive bounded overview, protected citations and source-dependent header. Upstream tree data separately reviewed below; no new runtime dependency or online service.

Adaptive Explore: original compact source index, stable nonmetric geometry, viewport detail selection and SVG rendering. OneZoom/Taxonium papers are conceptual background only; no upstream code, document, figure, dependency or new data included.

First-release preparation: original changelog, maintainer release instructions and v0.1.0 release notes. Selected UI screenshots are repository documentation only; browser/source release archives remain image-free.
Repository agent guidance: original development instructions in AGENTS.md, distributed with source packages under 0BSD.

Geometry maintenance: original versioned validation replay, bounded routing and incidence-completeness fixes, drag QA deferral, regression fixtures and offline guidance; no new third-party material or dependencies.

0.1.1 release review: package-lock changes only application version metadata; all locked dependency versions, integrity values, licenses and development-only scope are unchanged. Original release notes add no third-party material.

P00 naming migration, 2026-11-11: package name and development version metadata only; locked dependency versions, integrity values, licenses and development-only scope are unchanged. Legacy project/build/manifest identifiers and historical fixtures remain compatible.

P02/P03, 2026-11-11: incorporate and edit the user-supplied Teacher's Guide; generate offline HTML from its canonical Markdown using an original build-only renderer. No third-party runtime code or new dependency.

A01 Learn, 2026-11-11: original temporary practice model, UI, tests and guide updates; uses the separately reviewed bundled Upham source without changing its bytes or terms. No new data, third-party implementation, runtime dependency or saved project field.

A02, 2026-11-11: original local scenario format, staged validation, question-setup UI and regression tests. Reuses separately reviewed sources and citations; no new data, dependency, service or project schema field.
